definitions:
A placename
A place in the United States:
A home rule-class city in Harlan County, Kentucky.
An unincorporated community in Kent County, Maryland.
A township and village therein, in Boyd County, Nebraska.
A tributary of the North Fork Rivanna River, Virginia.
A place in England:
A hamlet in Berkeley parish, Stroud district, Gloucestershire . 
A hamlet in Overton parish, Basingstoke and Deane district, Hampshire . 
A hamlet in Selworthy parish, Somerset, previously in Somerset West and Taunton district .
A minor river at Hoddesdon, Hertfordshire, which joins the River Lea.

blocks.text: Lynch Island is an island lying in the eastern part of Marshall Bay, close off the south coast of Coronation Island in the South Orkney Islands, Antarctica.
Hull Bay is an ice-filled bay, about 25 nautical miles wide, fed by Hull Glacier, which descends into it between Lynch Point and Cape Burks, on the coast of Marie Byrd Land, Antarctica.
